12/G.goal: Explain the evaluation and mitigation of cybersickness in XR systems, including machine-learning evaluation categories, the presence trade-off, and developer- and user-side countermeasures.
12/G.achieves: Gives the learner a foundational ability to recognize, assess, and reduce a major XR challenge, preparing them to use or develop immersive applications more safely and effectively.

12/O1.goal: Classify machine-learning-based cybersickness evaluation approaches by model interpretability and by whether they detect or predict sickness as classes or sickness scores.
12/O1.achieves: Supports the course’s treatment of XR issues and challenges by enabling the learner to interpret and compare cybersickness evaluation methods when assessing immersive system experiences.

12/O2.goal: Describe how cybersickness mitigation involves a presence trade-off and compare developer-side and user-side countermeasures for reducing cybersickness.
12/O2.achieves: Lets the learner address a key psycho-physiological issue when using or designing XR systems, serving the course aim of understanding and implementing XR systems with confidence.
